translations.web: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
translations.bsb: Rescue those being led away to death, and restrain those stumbling toward the slaughter.
translations.kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
translations.asv: Deliver them that are carried away unto death, And those that are ready to be slain see that thou hold back.
